# Ministry of Education — Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

The selected object is the Ministry's online historical-language dictionary, entry 117543, accessed 8 September 2026. The 2021 label identifies the carrier; it does not date the ancient expression. Both definitions and their cited examples were read through the web-rendered entry. The saved curl HTML contains the page shell without definitions; the separately labelled web witness records the actual retrieval boundary.

<a id="passages"></a>
## Lexical witness

<a id="moe-2021-revised-mandarin-dictionary-q001"></a>
### q001 — 正名, zhèng míng

**Paraphrase:** Sense 1 concerns correcting the meaning of names so that name and actuality correspond. Its first example is the rectification passage in the Analects, Zi Lu; a separate example comes from Liu Xie's discussion of inscriptions. Sense 2 concerns a substantive official appointment as distinct from deputy or temporary office. It is a separate lexical use, not evidence that the Analects passage describes that appointment category.

**Locator:** entry 117543, 正名, pronunciation and definitions 1–2, including cited examples.

**Verification:** complete selected entry read 2026-09-08 at the [Ministry entry](https://dict.revised.moe.edu.tw/dictView.jsp?ID=117543&la=0&powerMode=0). Paraphrase-ready for the dictionary's account. The Analects passage has been read independently in its [received-text source house](../../../chinese-philosophy/confucius/analects-ctext-legge/analects-ctext-legge.md#analects-ctext-legge-q001), which **qualifies** the dictionary's abbreviated example. Liu Xie and the dramatic appointment example remain dictionary-mediated references, not primary passages read here.

The lexical distinction **sources** the independent Chinese comparison in [E4](../../../../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md). It establishes a recorded semantic use, not descent linking Chinese to the English Symbol / Account / Trust field. Modern Mandarin pronunciation is not a reconstruction of ancient speech.
